title: Loomwright — Weaving Draft Studio
description: Paint threading, tie-up and treadling; real cloth appears. Thirteen structures, yarn sequences, PNG and JSON export.
concept: A floor loom in a browser tab. Woven structure has exactly three inputs — which shaft each warp end rides (threading), which shafts each treadle lifts (tie-up), and which treadle throws each pick (treadling) — and one rule: an end sits on top of a pick when that pick's treadle lifts that end's shaft. Loomwright makes all three paintable and renders the resulting cloth live with shaded yarns, so you watch twill break into herringbone as you drag. Thirteen classical structures generate themselves for your shaft count, colour-sequence tools build tartan setts and houndstooth, and the float readouts tell you when you have woven something that would snag on a real loom.
features: Three paintable draft grids — threading, tie-up, treadling — with a live colour drawdown
Thirteen generated structures: plain, basket, 2/2 and 3/1 twill, herringbone, point twill, rosepath, birdseye, satin 5, waffle, houndstooth, tartan, shadow weave
Warp and weft yarn sequence tools: solid, alternate, stripes, mirrored tartan sett, gradient, random — applied to warp, weft or both
Three cloth render modes: shaded yarn, flat blocks, technical interlacement
Six re-dyeable yarns; tap the cloth to pick up the yarn under your finger
Live structure analysis — longest warp and weft float, warp-faced percentage, snag warnings
Resizable loom: 2–12 shafts, 2–12 treadles, 8–72 ends and picks, pattern preserved on resize
Export cloth as PNG, the draft as documented JSON, or copy a share link encoding the whole draft
Six localStorage save slots plus silent autosave, undo history, keyboard shortcuts
tech: Base36 draft encoding in the URL hash

interaction.mouse: Drag across the threading, tie-up, treadling or colour strips to paint; drag the cloth to pick up a yarn.
interaction.click: Tap a structure in the library, a yarn to select it (again to re-dye), or a sequence tool to redraw the colour order.
interaction.touch: Every grid paints under a finger; the draft auto-sizes to the screen so nothing needs pinching.
interaction.keyboard: 1–6 select a yarn, R generates a draft, Z undoes, E exports PNG, M cycles render mode.
